scene_decisions.location: Quiet daylight conservatory interior with pale painted window frames, a muted stone bench, and sparse soft green foliage in the background.
scene_decisions.season: Refined spring or early-autumn daytime atmosphere, consistent with the approved adult conservatory attire.
scene_decisions.weather: Calm overcast-bright daylight outside the windows; no visible rain, harsh sun, or dramatic weather effects.
scene_decisions.time: Late morning to early afternoon, providing stable natural illumination and a relaxed public-conservatory mood.
scene_decisions.subject_placement: Place Inaria slightly off-center, seated upright on the muted stone bench in a grounded three-quarter orientation. Keep sufficient negative space around the head, shoulders, hands, knees, ankles, and feet.
scene_decisions.background_layout: Use pale vertical window geometry as quiet framing behind or beside the subject. Place soft foliage farther into the background and keep the stone bench visibly supporting the seated pose. Avoid objects directly behind the head, hands, wrists, knees, ankles, or feet.
scene_decisions.scale_and_perspective: Believable human-to-bench and human-to-window scale. Use an eye-level 50mm-equivalent perspective with mild background separation and no wide-angle distortion.
scene_decisions.pose_readability: Preserve the approved seated three-quarter pose: torso slightly toward camera, level shoulders, one forearm resting naturally on the thigh, the other hand lightly holding the skirt edge, legs angled together, and both feet grounded with clear ankle and shoe contact.
scene_decisions.lighting: Soft diffused window light from camera-left with gentle frontal fill. Maintain readable facial planes, blue eyes, natural skin translucency, garment color separation, and subtle shadow transitions without heavy facial shadow.
scene_decisions.atmosphere: Quiet, airy, refined, and mildly dreamy, with restrained romantic Japanese-inspired portrait atmosphere. Keep the environment calm rather than theatrical.
scene_decisions.color_and_contrast: Use pale window frames, muted stone, and desaturated green foliage as a low-contrast backdrop. Preserve clear but gentle separation for the deep teal blouse, warm-gray skirt and flats, dark blue-black hair, and face.
scene_decisions.depth_control: Keep foliage and architectural details softly subordinate through moderate depth of field. Retain enough background definition to establish the conservatory without allowing texture or bokeh to compete with identity.
scene_decisions.camera_composition: Three-quarter medium-full portrait from head through feet, eye-level, approximately 50mm-equivalent. Include comfortable margins around hands and toes or closed-toe flats, with the face as the strongest visual anchor.
scene_decisions.environmental_safety: No mirrors, reflective glass showing duplicates, statues, posters, signage, plants crossing the face, hanging objects near the hands, or props that could create accidental limbs or identity signals.

locked_constraints: Preserve the approved age-20 identity reference, recognizable facial structure, natural Taiwanese/Asian adult presentation, blue eyes, and dark blue-black hair.
Keep the quiet conservatory interior with pale window frames, soft green foliage, and a muted stone bench as the supporting environment.
Preserve the approved seated upright three-quarter pose, grounded balance, readable torso, hands, knees, ankles, and feet.
Use an eye-level three-quarter medium-full composition with approximately 50mm-equivalent perspective and no wide-angle distortion.
Frame from head through feet with adequate margin around both hands and the lower legs; do not crop anatomy-critical regions.
Keep the face unobstructed by foliage, window bars, props, hair, hands, accessories, or heavy shadow.
Use soft diffused camera-left daylight with gentle frontal fill so identity, facial planes, skin texture, clothing, and anatomy remain evaluable.
Keep the background secondary, uncluttered, correctly scaled, and free of accidental identity signals.
Maintain believable perspective, bench support, seated balance, floor contact, and natural object placement.
Do not introduce additional people, duplicate subjects, mirrors, reflective duplicates, text, signage, logos, watermarks, or distracting props.
Avoid strong color casts, dramatic rim light, harsh contrast, fog obscuring anatomy, excessive bloom, plastic smoothing, or decorative effects.

Preserve exactly five plausible fingers on each visible hand and exactly five plausible toes on each visible foot when visible; closed-toe flats may limit direct toe visibility but must show natural foot shape and contact.
No extra limbs, impossible joints, duplicated feet, malformed ankles, floating body parts, or environment-induced anatomy distortions.

intentional_variations.scene_meaning: Add controlled environmental diversity through a quiet conservatory setting rather than a plain studio or portrait backdrop.
intentional_variations.seasonal_read: Suggest spring or early autumn through gentle daylight, restrained foliage, and polished daytime attire without adding conspicuous seasonal props.
intentional_variations.architectural_variation: Use pale window frames and measured vertical geometry to create subtle structure and depth while keeping the face dominant.
intentional_variations.natural_element_variation: Include sparse soft green foliage placed behind and to the side of Inaria, never crossing the face or overlapping hands and feet.
intentional_variations.seating_variation: Use a muted stone bench that visibly supports the seated pose and harmonizes with the warm-gray skirt and flats.
intentional_variations.lighting_variation: Introduce mild directional daylight from camera-left with soft fill, preserving identity evaluation while differing from flat frontal studio light.
intentional_variations.composition_variation: Place Inaria slightly off-center with quiet window and foliage framing, maintaining a clear head-to-feet silhouette and generous anatomy margins.
intentional_variations.atmospheric_variation: Use an airy, calm, lightly dreamy mood with moderate background separation rather than dramatic haze or stylized environmental effects.
intentional_variations.controlled_background_detail: Allow only low-contrast, softly resolved foliage and architecture; keep all high-frequency detail away from the face, hands, knees, ankles, and feet.

notes.production_guidance: Generate one integrated image using the approved identity and clothing references. Treat the conservatory as a supportive contextual layer. Prioritize identity, age-20 presentation, facial readability, stable seated anatomy, exact-digit hand checks, natural foot and shoe contact, and believable perspective before decorative atmosphere.
notes.scene_prompt_summary: inr20, Inaria age 20 seated upright on a muted stone bench inside a quiet daylight conservatory, pale window frames, sparse soft green foliage in the distant background, spring or early-autumn late-morning atmosphere, soft diffused light from camera-left with gentle frontal fill, eye-level 50mm-equivalent three-quarter medium-full portrait, head through grounded feet, calm refined dreamy mood, uncluttered background, face-first visual hierarchy.
adjustable_choices: Minor variation in window-frame spacing, foliage species, stone texture, and background blur is acceptable if scale, color restraint, and anatomy clearance remain stable.
The outside view may remain softly indistinct or show pale neutral daylight, provided it does not introduce signage, crowds, strong weather, or competing scenery.
Foliage density may vary slightly but must remain sparse and away from the face, hands, knees, ankles, and feet.
Subtle variation in daylight warmth is acceptable if blue eyes, dark blue-black hair, deep teal blouse, warm-gray skirt, and natural skin tones remain accurate.
unresolved_conflicts: Closed-toe flats limit direct toe inspection; prioritize clear shoe shape, natural ankle alignment, grounded soles, and absence of duplicated or malformed foot forms.
The seated stone bench and skirt may overlap part of the lower body, but the environment and fabric must not obscure both knees, ankles, or the readable placement of both feet.
Moderate background separation is desirable, but blur must not reduce face, hand, garment-intersection, or footwear readability.
notes.quality_gate: PASS only if the conservatory reads clearly but remains subordinate, the face is unobstructed and well lit, the subject is correctly scaled to the bench and architecture, the three-quarter seated pose is balanced, both hands remain inspectable, both feet show natural contact, and no environmental clutter or duplicate forms appear.
notes.repair_policy: Any scene repair requires a complete recheck of identity, apparent age, facial visibility, hair and eye color, clothing, pose, hands, feet, joints, balance, bench support, perspective, lighting, background clutter, reflections, text, duplicate subjects, and unwanted artifacts.
rejection_triggers: Background dominates the subject or creates an accidental identity signal
Face obscured by foliage, window geometry, shadow, reflections, or decorative objects
Incorrect scale, perspective, floating seating, implausible bench contact, or unstable seated balance
Hands, knees, ankles, or feet cropped, hidden, fused with props, or rendered too small for inspection
Harsh lighting, strong color cast, dramatic haze, excessive blur, plastic skin, or loss of facial planes
Mirrors, reflective duplicates, additional people, text, signage, logos, watermark, or duplicate subject
Environmental objects resembling extra limbs or creating impossible joints
Identity drift, age drift, wrong hair or eye color, malformed hands or feet, or clothing obscured by the scene
notes.dataset_role: This image adds controlled conservatory, seated-bench, spring or early-autumn daylight, off-center composition, soft foliage framing, and gentle directional-light diversity while preserving identity, anatomy stability, clothing readability, and a face-first visual hierarchy.
